doc.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
doc.interviewee: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum

title: Old band uniforms and Papa's banner
summary: They describe the old blue braided uniforms with mandarin collars and ask about the whereabouts of the banner.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Is there anything you can tell us about the uniforms the bands used in the old days? Oh, Lord. Now they, like Chic and all of them, they play now just dark pants and a hat. They don't have a coat.
But they used to have the whole, Lord. Used to have the old. One time they had the whole blue uniform. The whole blue suit with that bread on. The bread on. Yeah.

They had that bread. With all the bread on. The bread on the side of his pants. The bread on the side of the pants. Yeah. The big red spot and a mandarin collar. Yeah. Oh, yes. They don't have that. That's the kind of thing. They're looking for something other shed at home. They're looking for something other shed at home. Yeah. The other day, we showed them that. The picture that you and I gave him. The picture of Papa's hand. He saved my hand. I know you had your, I don't know, nothing to do. I don't know. The dog must have took it. I was showing the dog one day and it went off. What?
The black. The black. The black. The black. The black. But one thing I haven't seen and that's Papa's banner, I have never seen.
Well, that picture of the banner, yes. They don't have those anymore for the banners. They didn't give it to you. Who didn't you give it to? Junior gave it to you. You gave it to Junior.
